name: jlcpcb-aluminium-1layer
description: JLCPCB single-layer aluminium (metal core) boards, HASL. Drill, slot and board-size limits from jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities (read 2026-09-05); JLCPCB gives no separate trace/spacing figure for aluminium, so 0.15 mm is used as a conservative one. No plated holes or vias exist on this process.

rules.name: design-rules-silk
rules.description: Silkscreen stroke and text-height minimums are legibility guidance, not process limits.

rules.name: no-vias
rules.description: A single-layer metal-core board has no plated holes at all.

rules.name: copper-gap
rules.description: Same-net copper closer than 0.25 mm without touching (a pad beside its own via, a trace grazing its pad) is an etch sliver or an acid trap; JLCPCB's same-net spacing figure.

rules.name: silk-text-height
rules.description: Text under 1 mm prints but may not be legible.

rules.name: mask-bridge
rules.description: Mask between openings thinner than 0.05 mm will not survive at all: two bare features sit exposed side by side under the finish.

rules.name: via-near-pad
rules.description: An untented via inside or within 0.2 mm of a pad merges its mask opening with the pad's and wicks paste down the hole; escape by the pad's half extent plus the via radius plus 0.2 mm, or tent the vias (`rules set tent_vias=1`).

rules.name: designator-format
rules.description: JLCPCB upper-cases every designator and reads the component type from its letter prefix: use upper-case letters followed by digits (R1, LED12), never two names that differ only in case.

rules.name: bom-prefixes
rules.description: Parts on one BOM row (same component, value and LCSC number) must share a designator prefix. JLCPCB's BOM review determines the component type from the prefix and holds the order for confirmation when one row appears to contain several types.
